subtitle: Industrial systems and software deployed in real operational environments

description.summary: Traceability system integrating vision inspection with Ignition SCADA for production line validation.
description.context: Manufacturing environment requiring component-level tracking and validation across multiple production stages with real-time operator feedback.
description.challenge: Handling inconsistent vision reads and synchronization issues between inspection systems and SCADA without interrupting production flow.
description.solution: Implemented synchronization logic between vision systems and Ignition SCADA, including retry handling, state management, and operator feedback through HMI interfaces.

description.summary: Configuration of industrial time-series data systems for monitoring, analysis, and production performance tracking.
description.context: Centralized data collection from production assets, including tag management and integration from DCS systems via OPC paths.
description.challenge: Structuring raw time-series data into usable asset hierarchies and events while maintaining consistency and scalability across large tag databases.
description.solution: Configured and managed PI System infrastructure, including tag creation and management from DCS systems via OPC, AF modeling, Event Frames, and development of display.

description.summary: Web-based system for managing shift reports with real-time collaboration and document integrity validation.
description.context: Industrial environment requiring reliable transfer of operational information between work shifts.
description.challenge: Avoiding conflicting edits, ensuring real-time coordination between operators, and guaranteeing document integrity once reports are finalized.
description.solution: Developed a full-stack application with real-time communication (WebSockets), document reservation system, and checksum-based validation to ensure integrity and traceability of reports.

description.summary: Excel-based automation tools for operational reporting and production tracking.
description.context: Production environments where manual reporting was still required.
description.challenge: Reducing manual errors and repetitive data processing tasks.
description.solution: Built VBA macros to automate data collection, reporting workflows, and KPI tracking.
